title: PAH root-transition measure prospective owner decision draft
question: Can the first unresolved root-label and measure decision be presented to the owner without pretending that an approved PAH model or semigroup bridge already exists?
finding: One versioned owner decision draft separates fixed PAH-001 text from proposed root multiplicity, invalid-move and root-pairing conventions. It recommends R-527 Option A as a prospective labelled-channel completion and compares only R-527's two existing interpretations. The pi-weighted unit-count root measure is proposed with the unchanged displayed B factor. No root specification is admitted, no new finite computation is made, and the original PAH-OMC-020/030 HOLD remains unchanged.
decision_reason: The operator explicitly requested a decision artifact rather than another owner scan. Selecting multiplicity is not retroactive source recovery: either alternative can select a different numerical generator. The draft therefore requires a new versioned completion and fresh applicability/verification before use; approval of a draft alone cannot satisfy R-557.
method: Read the immutable PAH-001 source, R-527 result and certificate, and the R-557 ten-field admission contract.
Hash-pin those four sources and verify the four existing R-527 run-file hashes, without rerunning a calculation or Lean proof.
Separate source-fixed functional, rates, state and time from the proposed root enumeration, validity and Hilbert pairing.
Compare the two existing R-527 interpretations at their original finite witness and explicitly reject an inferred global time-rescaling equivalence.
Write one English-only versioned decision document with five concrete self-review objections, an authority/version firewall and one owner approval question.

exact_scope.evidence: R-527's existing K=2, Q=0 closed-face multiplicity witness only; no additional carrier, state, parameter fit or calculation.

verification.document_encoding: ASCII subset of UTF-8, LF only; draft byte hash recorded above.

boundary: Documentary decision support only. No PAH-001 source changes, no proof or tier promotion, no new result ID, no replacement of R-527 or R-557 and no gate closure. No synthesis PDF is warranted for an unapproved definition decision.
next_action: Submit the single approval question in draft section 8. Await an explicit owner decision naming version 0.1 and its hash. If approved, separately prepare the authorized prospective model version and its exact-source applicability audit; do not silently reopen the unchanged-source PAH-OMC-030 theorem.
revisit_condition: A recorded owner decision identifying this exact draft version/hash, or a substantive correction to the pinned source evidence. No repeated owner search or conditional-proof replay is scheduled.
non_claims: No detailed-balance, B*B=-L, projection/common-core, finite-to-minimal-semigroup or ordered-convergence proof for a proposed completion.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE conclusion.
